reset.title: Reset time
reset.label: Resets at
reset.help: In-game missions and My tasks both clear at this time every day, in UTC. The package has no reset time, so 00:00 UTC is the app default. You can change it.
reset.helpMobile: In-game missions and My tasks both clear at {time} every day. The package has no reset time, so 00:00 UTC is the app default. You change it in Edit list.
reset.helpSheet: The reset time also clears the In-game missions.

resetDialog.title: Reset the dailies now?
resetDialog.body: This clears both sides of the page. In-game Daily Missions: {missions} with a level done, which is {activeness} Activeness. My tasks: {marks}.
resetDialog.marks: {count, plural, one {{amount} done mark} other {{amount} done marks}}
resetDialog.keep: Your My tasks list stays as it is. The next automatic reset stays at {time}.
resetDialog.undo: You can undo for a few seconds after the reset.

activity.title: In-game Daily Missions
activity.intro: From the data package. Each level adds its own Activeness on top of the levels below it.
activity.known: Every known level of every mission adds up to {all}. Level 1 alone gives {first}. The top reward needs {top}.

missions.title: Missions
missions.intro: Pick the highest level you finished today. A mission with one level only has a Done switch.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.intro: Your own checklist. You add, rename, remove and reorder it.
tasks.emptyDescription: Add a task of your own or restore the starter list. The in-game missions are not affected.

starter.title: Starter list
starter.description: The app author writes the starter list. Your list is a copy you can change. Newer versions never overwrite your edits.
starter.descriptionSheet: Your list started as a copy of the starter list.
